defs.meaning: [电子]显示（display 的单三形式）；展示

examples.en: This column displays the title of the mail message.
Charles displays unreserved admiration for his grandfather.
examples.zh: 查尔斯对他祖父表现出毫不保留的崇敬。

examples.en: They were dazed by window displays dripping with diamonds and furs.
examples.zh: 他们被布满钻石和毛皮的橱窗展示弄得眼花缭乱。
